verses.text: Blessed na everyone wey fear di Lord, wey waka for im ways.
You go eat di labor of your hands. You go dey blessed, and e go dey well with you.
Your wife go be like fruitful vine inside your house. Your pikin dem go be like olive shoots round your table.
Look, na so di man wey fear di Lord go dey blessed.
Di Lord go bless you from Zion. You go see di good of Jerusalem all di days of your life.
Yes, you go see your pikin dem pikin. Peace dey on Israel.
“Dem don afflict me plenty from my youth,” make Israel talk now.
“Dem don afflict me plenty from my youth, yet dem no win against me.
Plowers plow on my back. Dem make dem furrows long.”
Di Lord dey righteous. E don cut di cords of di wicked in two.
Make all dem wey hate Zion dey ashamed and turn back.
Make dem be like grass for di housetops, wey dey wither before e grow up,
wey di reaper no fit fill im hand with, nor di one wey dey bind sheaves fill im arms.
Make dem wey dey pass no talk say, “Di blessing of di Lord dey on you. We bless you for di name of di Lord.”
Out of di depths I don cry to you, Lord.
Lord, hear my voice. Make your ears dey attentive to di voice of my supplications.
If you, Lord, mark iniquities, Lord, who fit stand?
But forgiveness dey with you, so dat you go dey feared.
I wait for di Lord. My soul dey wait, and I hope for im word.
My soul dey wait for di Lord more pass watchmen wait for di morning, yes, more pass watchmen wait for di morning.
Israel, hope for di Lord, because with di Lord dey faithful love, and with am dey plenty redemption.
E go redeem Israel from all im iniquities.

chapters.title: A song of ascents. By David.

verses.text: Lord, my heart no proud, nor my eyes lofty. I no dey follow great matters, or things too wonderful for me.
Surely I don calm and quiet my soul, like weaned child with im mama. My soul inside me dey like weaned child.
Israel, hope for di Lord from dis time forth and forevermore.
Lord, remember David and all im affliction,
how e swear to di Lord and vow to di Mighty One of Jacob:
“I no go enter di tent of my house or go up to my bed,
I no go give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
until I find place for di Lord, dwelling place for di Mighty One of Jacob.”
Look, we hear about am for Ephrathah. We find am for di fields of Jaar.
Make we go into im dwelling place. Make we worship at im footstool.
Arise, Lord, to your resting place, you and di ark of your strength.
Make your priests dey clothed with righteousness. Make your holy ones shout for joy.
For David your servant sake, no turn away di face of your anointed one.
Di Lord don swear to David wey e no go turn from: “Di fruit of your body I go set on your throne.
If your pikin dem keep my covenant and my testimony wey I go teach dem, dem pikin dem go sit on your throne forever.”
Because di Lord don choose Zion. E don desire am for im habitation:
“Dis na my resting place forever. Here I go dwell, because I don desire am.
I go greatly bless im provision. I go satisfy im poor with bread.
I go also clothe im priests with salvation, and im holy ones go shout aloud for joy.
Dere I go make David horn grow. I don prepare lamp for my anointed one.
I go clothe im enemies with shame, but on am im crown go shine.”

chapters.title: A song of ascents. By David.

verses.text: Look, how good and how pleasant e be for brothers to dwell together for unity!
E be like di precious oil upon di head, wey run down on di beard, even Aaron beard, wey run down on di collar of im robes,
like di dew of Hermon, wey dey fall on di hills of Zion. Because dere di Lord command di blessing, even life forevermore.
Look, bless di Lord, all una servants of di Lord, wey dey stand for di house of di Lord for night.
Lift up your hands for di sanctuary and bless di Lord.
Make di Lord wey make heaven and earth bless you from Zion.
Praise di Lord. Praise di name of di Lord. Praise am, una servants of di Lord,
una wey stand for di house of di Lord, for di courts of di house of our God.
Praise di Lord, because di Lord good. Sing praises to im name, because e dey pleasant.
Because di Lord don choose Jacob for imself, Israel for im own treasure.
Because I know say di Lord great, and our Lord dey above all gods.
Whatever di Lord please, e do for heaven and for earth, for di seas and for all deeps.
E cause di clouds to rise from di ends of di earth. E make lightnings for di rain. E bring out di wind from im storehouses.
E strike di firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
E send signs and wonders into di middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh and on all im servants.
E strike great nations and kill mighty kings:
Sihon king of di Amorites, Og king of Bashan and all di kingdoms of Canaan,
and give dem land as inheritance, inheritance to Israel im people.
Your name, Lord, dey forever, your renown, Lord, through all generations.
Because di Lord go judge im people and have compassion on im servants.
Di idols of di nations na silver and gold, di work of men hands.
Dem get mouth, but dem no fit speak. Dem get eyes, but dem no fit see.
Dem get ears, but dem no fit hear. Nor breath dey for dem mouth.
Dem wey make dem go be like dem, yes, everyone wey trust dem.
House of Israel, bless di Lord. House of Aaron, bless di Lord.
House of Levi, bless di Lord. Una wey fear di Lord, bless di Lord.
Blessed be di Lord from Zion, wey dwell for Jerusalem. Praise di Lord.
Give thanks to di Lord, because e good, because im faithful love dey forever.
Give thanks to di God of gods, because im faithful love dey forever.
Give thanks to di Lord of lords, because im faithful love dey forever.
To am alone wey do great wonders, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey make di heavens by understanding, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey spread out di earth above di waters, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey make di great lights, because im faithful love dey forever,
di sun to rule by day, because im faithful love dey forever,
di moon and stars to rule by night, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey strike Egypt for dem firstborn, because im faithful love dey forever,
and bring Israel out from among dem, because im faithful love dey forever,
with strong hand and outstretched arm, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey divide di Red Sea in two, because im faithful love dey forever,
and make Israel pass through am, because im faithful love dey forever,
but overthrow Pharaoh and im army for di Red Sea, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey lead im people through di wilderness, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey strike great kings, because im faithful love dey forever,
and kill famous kings, because im faithful love dey forever,
Sihon king of di Amorites, because im faithful love dey forever,
and Og king of Bashan, because im faithful love dey forever,
and give dem land as inheritance, because im faithful love dey forever,
even inheritance to Israel im servant, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey remember us for our low state, because im faithful love dey forever,
and deliver us from our enemies, because im faithful love dey forever,
to am wey give food to all flesh, because im faithful love dey forever.
Give thanks to di God of heaven, because im faithful love dey forever.
By di rivers of Babylon, dere we sit down. Yes, we weep when we remember Zion.
On di willows for di middle of am, we hang up our harps.
Because dere dem wey carry us captive ask us for songs, and dem wey torment us ask for mirth, say, “Sing us one of di songs of Zion.”
How we go sing di Lord song for strange land?
If I forget you, Jerusalem, make my right hand forget im skill.
Make my tongue stick to di roof of my mouth, if I no remember you, if I no set Jerusalem above my chief joy.
Remember, Lord, against di sons of Edom di day of Jerusalem, how dem talk say, “Raze am, raze am, down to im foundation!”
Daughter of Babylon, wey go dey destroyed, blessed na im wey repay you as you don serve us.
Blessed na im wey take your small ones and dash dem against di rock.
